description: The file defines the AdaptableBuilder interface, which provides methods for setting payload and headers, and for building an Adaptable instance. It serves as a builder pattern interface within the Eclipse Ditto project to facilitate creation of Adaptable objects with specified payload and headers.

classes.name: AdaptableBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a builder for creating Adaptable instances, allowing to set payload and headers before building the final Adaptable object.

methods.name: withPayload
methods.description: Sets the payload for the Adaptable being built. Replaces previously set payload.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Sets the headers for the Adaptable being built. Replaces previously set headers.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns an Adaptable instance based on the set payload and headers.
